title: Little workhorse washing machine
text:
I don't understand the bad reviews. This appliance does what it's supposed to do and exceeds all expectations. The bad reviews are fake or from people who can't hold a screwdriver and talk at the same time.
Make sure the drain hose is pushed onto the steel pump drain out tube (bottom rear of appliance) all the way in and make sure the clamp is set securely and properly around it.
Read the manual and follow the instructions they provide.
I'm washing several loads a day and it is performing like any large size washing machine just smaller.
And Amazon delivery is the best there is. Ordered Thurs morning received everything for this order Fri afternoon.
Order this washing machine if you need a small machine and have a sink and power supply close by.
I also ordered a four wheel flat base dolly to set it on.. Perfect.
Thanks all who worked hard to get my much needed appliances to me. Amazon is ruling the roost and I am much impressed.
Update: I've had this machine about 2 weeks now and I just have to say this is one of the best appliances I ever have purchased for it's usefulness and dependability. Don't overload it and don't use too much detergent for perfect results every time. It gets your clothes clean, rinses and spins them almost completely dry. No more public laundry rooms for me.

text: These are ok... I am always looking for ways to make my Keurig more cost effective. These disposable filters are meant to be used with your "use your own coffee" inserts.  They do make it easy to pull out the grounds from your insert, but once they are wet, they edges are hard to grab up. Definitely wait until it has cooled a second or two before grabbing it. Also, it limits the amount of coffee you can actually put in the insert. After you start buying the inserts (plastic, stainless steel..etc), the cups for the inserts, etc...  I keep wondering if I should just go back to buying the Kcups.  It's still a bit cheaper, even with these paper liners so then I guess it comes down to if you want to do the 2 second kcup or spend a minute or two filling your insert.  A personal choice for everyone to make.
